title: Compute the ordered weak-coupling detuning linewidth
statement: For fixed sufficiently small nonzero g,then delta->0,the local continued pole obeys Gamma=-2 Im z_pole=2pi delta^2 S_g(lambda)+O_g(delta^4). Afterwards g->0 gives 2pi S_g(lambda)=[64 b^2/(27pi)]g^8+o(g^8),b=4/sqrt(3)-2,with positive coefficient about0.0722287299931.

requires: Exact same-end hard-core ladder with relative memory-frequency error delta(n_L-n_R)
Complete dressed source and hard-core scattering correction;fixed nonzero sufficiently small g before the small-error limit
provides: Local second-sheet pole with nonzero response residue,even detuning expansion and positive eighth-order linewidth coefficient
Exact integral16/(27pi^2) carries the leading coefficient;bare-source cancellation alone misses the leading scattering correction
Formal plateau loss exponent Gamma*pi/|chi|~64 delta^2 g^4/(81sqrt(3)),with chi=-3ab g^4,a=4-2sqrt(3),b=a/sqrt(3)
assumptions: No exchange of the small-error and weak-g limits;threshold distance shrinks O(g^2) and a nearby harmonic mixed atom has O(g^4) separation
Pole/plateau formula excludes loading,unloading,relative one-body calibration,echo and time-domain errors
Ordinary bath loss kappa has population3bg^2+O(g^4),giving formal plateau exponent pi*kappa/(a*g^2),which increases as g decreases
costs: Exact ideal spectral calculation;no acquired experimental source,loss model or actuator calibration
Numerical convergence is evidence for coefficient computations,not a uniform remainder or finite-error enclosure
